ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what does the emperor scorpion get its food energy from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with "Emperor Scorpion" labeled on the left, and "Beetle" slightly to the lower right below it. In the diagram there is a black arrow from the position of Beetle pointing to Emperor Scorpion. Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate the direction of food energy flow, that is, from the organism being eaten to the organism obtaining energy. Because the arrow points from beetle to emperor scorpion, the food energy of emperor scorpion comes from beetle.
